text: Désolée, it's late. Granddaughter Léa, 5. She hadn't pooed for three days and was very grumpy about it, then tonight it came out runny. I think that's ok? She's drinking well and weeing normally. Also her legs are purple all over and I nearly had a heart attack, mon Dieu, but it's felt tip. She drew on herself and it came off in the bath. Not sure if I should worry about the poo.
